summary: __stdcall routine that locks a D3D texture surface (D3DTextureSurfaceLockCopy), fills a header and payload descriptor from arguments, initializes a D3D context (D3DContextInit), then unconditionally tears down the render resources and dual-vtable objects. Fails fast with -2005530516 when a1 is null or when a4/a8 are null, and propagates negative HRESULT-style results from the two D3D calls. a9 defaults to 524292 when passed as -1.

local_names.v15: six-dword descriptor payload copied from a8[0..3], 0, 1
